climate.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), based on Copernicus ERA5 reanalysis. Model estimates, not station observations or forecasts.
climate.rainDefinition: Historical total rain (rain_sum) divided by all calendar days, including dry days; expressed in mm/day. Not rain probability or hourly intensity.
climate.humidityDefinition: Daily mean outdoor relative humidity; comfort preference only, not a health assessment.
climate.temperatureDefinition: Mean of actual daily mean 2-m temperatures, aggregated by local calendar month; not the mean of daily maxima.

peru.rainDefinition: PRECTOTCORR total precipitation, including snow, averaged across all calendar days in mm/day. Alternative to ERA5 rain-only data due daily API quota; not directly identical.

method.crowdBands: Within-base ranks converted continuously to 0–100; first four BEST, next four AVERAGE, last four WORST. Editorial proxies, not measured visitor counts.
method.priceBands: Within-base ranks converted continuously to 0–100; first four BEST, next four AVERAGE, last four WORST. Editorial accommodation-demand proxies.
method.festivalScore: Keep evidence scores 100/50/0. Do not invent BEST event months where no events are listed. Final tourist rating still uses a 4/4/4 quota.
method.overall: Rank the weighted tourist score within each base and year. First four BEST, middle four AVERAGE, last four WORST. BEST is relative, not a guarantee of ideal weather.
method.calendar: Typical recurring months, not guaranteed event schedules. Carnival and Santo Cristo follow Easter; Easter demand shifts are approximations. Confirm event dates before travel.
method.limitations: Crowd and price inputs are provisional editorial proxies and must be replaced by measured monthly data when available. Full-month averages hide short holiday spikes; climate grid cells can miss coastal and mountain microclimates.
method.ranking: Within each base only: ranks 1–4 BEST, 5–8 AVERAGE, 9–12 WORST. Equal values use January–December order to enforce exactly four per band.
method.climateScoring: Temperature: absolute distance from base-type target (standard 19°C, beach 25°C, winter −5°C); rain: absolute distance from 5 mm/calendar day; humidity: absolute distance from 55%. Rank only the base’s own 12 months; rank score = 100 × (12 − rank) / 11. Climate is 50% temperature, 30% rain, 20% humidity. Symmetric deviations, then calendar-order tie-breaking, preserve 4/4/4 bands. Beach destinations double the temperature component weight before normalizing: temperature 2/3, rain 1/5, humidity 2/15. Multiplying deviation values before ranking alone would not change ranks.
method.destinationTypePolicy: Exactly one active primary climate type per base. Beach means a beach-oriented holiday base; winter means a well-established ski/winter-holiday base. A coast or Christmas market alone does not classify every mixed-purpose city. This editorial assignment is reviewable and is not a claim that the base has only one season. All season uses a temperature comfort interval, not a single target. Named owner-approved assignments override a later imported profile default. All season has no forced temperature-component bands; rain, humidity, combined climate and final tourist ratings retain within-base ranks.

allSeason.formula: MAX(0, rain rank score × 0.80 + humidity rank score × 0.20 − 5 × MAX(−5 − daily mean °C, 0, daily mean °C − 25)). Rain target 0 mm/day. Inclusive neutral range; no temperature rank.

beach.ratingPolicy: No forced quota. Below 16°C is UNSUITABLE and ineligible for recommendations. Otherwise BEST >=60, AVERAGE >=40, WORST <40 overall points.

winter.missingDataPolicy: PENDING and excluded from Winter recommendations until mountain temperature, snowfall and snow-cover evidence are complete.
